title: simethis planifolia
intro: Simethis planifolia, commonly known as the "plai" plant, is a species of ginger native to Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Thai and other Southeast Asian healing practices, where it is used to relieve pain and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Simethis planifolia include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and alleviating digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and phenolic compounds, which possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
